exclusions.name: Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule; her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital; other entities are irrelevant.

exclusions.name: Blood usage or transfusions at the hospital

exclusions.name: Spoilage or wastage
exclusions.why_safe: No evidence mentions spoilage; assuming no wastage is safe given the evidence.
